overview: The City Council approved a $1.1 million free cash appropriation for public safety and public works equipment, advanced an amended University Accountability Act, and passed resolutions concerning board meeting accessibility and neighborhood traffic issues.

items.title: University Accountability Act Committee Report and First Reading
items.summary: The council adopted the Committee of the Whole report as amended and approved the first reading of the ordinance regarding Tufts University student housing accountability and code enforcement.

items.title: Victualer's License for Zam Zam's Restaurant
items.summary: Approved a victualer's license for Zam Zam's Restaurant at 42 Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Highway Catch-Basin Overtime Transfer
items.summary: Approved a $50,000 transfer from highway materials to highway overtime to pay municipal crews conducting in-house catch-basin repairs.

items.title: Free Cash Capital Equipment Appropriation
items.summary: Approved a $1,105,000 appropriation from certified free cash for 12 police cruisers, body armor, speed monitors, DPW vehicles and radios, and fire department turnout gear and computer upgrades.

items.title: Honor Roll Park Veteran Plaques
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the mayor to fund adding local veterans to plaques at Honor Roll Park, amended to establish this as an annual Memorial Day practice.

items.title: Postal Truck Parking on Forest Street
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting city officials address postal vehicles parking along Forest Street, amended to ask the Traffic Commission to study commercial parking ban feasibility.

items.title: Public Comment: Traffic and Island Safety
items.summary: Resident Sharon Deyeso thanked the fire department, noted the installation of a stop sign at Ashcroft Road, and requested highway safety reflectors on a Mystic Avenue median island.

items.title: Board and Commission Meeting Accessibility
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution suggesting all city boards and commissions move to larger venues like the Council Chambers to accommodate overflow crowds and televise their proceedings.

items.title: St. Clement's Gym Rental Parking
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the mayor to contact St. Clement's Parish to review neighborhood parking protocols with groups renting its gymnasium.

items.title: Commendations and Condolences
items.summary: Congratulated resident Richard Fitzpatrick on his 90th birthday and held moments of silence for the passing of Josephine Panico and Dennis Hurley.
